title: MAS-Loop: Beyond One-Shot Orchestration towards Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.38946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training-time multi-agent system (MAS) design seeks to learn reusable orchestration policies, yet prevailing approaches remain largely one-shot: an Orchestrator generates a system but only observes and learns from its terminal outcome. This paradigm discards execution trajectories that expose system-level failures and contain fine-grained information beyond the terminal outcome, leaving no direct basis for revising the source MAS, evaluating the updated MAS, or learning from the resulting contrast. To this end, we introduce MAS-Loop, an execution-grounded framework that closes this feedback loop by coupling an Orchestrator with a trajectory-conditioned Refiner. For each task, the Orchestrator constructs and executes a source MAS to obtain an outcome score and an intermediate trajectory. translated_title: MAS-Loop：超越一次性编排，迈向自演化的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 训练阶段的多智能体系统（MAS）设计旨在学习可复用的编排策略，然而主流方法在很大程度上仍然是一次性的：编排器生成一个系统，但仅观察并学习其最终结果。这一范式丢弃了能够暴露系统级故障的执行轨迹，而这些轨迹包含超越最终结果的细粒度信息，导致没有直接依据来修改源MAS、评估更新后的MAS或从由此产生的对比中学习。为此，我们提出了MAS-Loop，一个以执行为基础的框架，通过将编排器与以轨迹为条件的精炼器相耦合，闭环了这一反馈回路。对于每个任务，编排器构建并执行一个源MAS，以获得结果分数和中间轨迹；精炼器则以该轨迹为条件，定位可操作的故障点，制定基于轨迹的诊断，并提出有界的修补方案来……
tldr: MAS-Loop通过将编排器与基于轨迹条件的精炼器相耦合，利用执行轨迹中的细粒度信息闭环反馈回路，突破了传统一次性编排范式的局限，实现多智能体系统的自演化。
en_tdlr: MAS-Loop closes the one-shot orchestration feedback loop by coupling an Orchestrator with a trajectory-conditioned Refiner, leveraging fine-grained execution trajectories to enable self-evolving multi-agent systems.
